title: The Goblin Camp
description: A major Goblin camp has a leader willing to deal with you. Hear the creature out before deciding what use, if any, this local polity may have.
description_completed: The designated Goblin camp has formally entered the Overlord's notice. Its political outcome remains unresolved.

dialogue.offer: Big boss comes to Goblin camp. Good. Goblins have ears, knives, and business. Mostly knives. You want to know this camp, you talk to me.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: There. You listened. Now you know who speaks for this camp, and I know the new Overlord can hear words as well as screaming.
dialogue.completed: This camp remembers you, big boss. That can be useful. Or expensive. Usually both.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign

rewards.name: Record formal contact with the designated Goblin camp
